title: fix(goals): recover unconfirmed controls after reconnects
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: goal controls can stay unconfirmed after a lost reply, while a committed change can be reported as failed when its notification fails.

## User Impact

Operators can explicitly check an unconfirmed Pause, Resume, Clear, or edit after reconnecting or reloading, even when the original goal control disappeared. Nothing resumes automatically. Saved requests expire after 24 hours; forgetting the browser or switching accounts removes the previous account's saved payloads for that Gateway. Controls are not sent or restored when the connection has no distinguishable recovery owner.

## Why This Change Was Made

The existing durable receipt remains the outcome authority. A bounded request and tab-scoped saved identity let the independent recovery notice retry that same operation without creating a second continuation. Definitive precommit rejections leave no armed retry, while unknown outcomes retain their identity. Server-reported receipt expiry strips the saved payload and retains a refresh fence, including in-flight expiry and clock skew. A committed change stays successful despite notification failure, without releasing its event-writer custody early.

## Evidence

- Current head: `4fe5f7364c18f99fd3d177c04bd06fcfca542971`; captured main: `5607b5e4223a80fddc9586776b153eb76a799cdc`. The three Goal patches and Anthropic fixture patch are unchanged: all four commits are equivalent in range-diff, aggregate zero-context patch ID `81430330230af6c199c5c53d17361b3c8d8b3c6b`.
- The predecessor's [exact-head primary CI](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/35543340319) **passed: 164 successful jobs, 12 skipped, no failures or pending jobs**. Its watcher stopped only because main independently landed the same Claw fixture correction in [#154120](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/154120), creating a merge conflict. The redundant Claw commit is now dropped; that test is byte-identical to main. This is a conflict-driven refresh, not a rerun of a red job. The [current-head primary CI](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/35544294983) **passed: 164 successful jobs, 12 skipped, zero failures or pending jobs**. Both published `openclaw/ci-gate` required contexts are successful. The optional ClawSweeper metadata-dispatch cancellation was not rerun; a later exact-head completed review is authenticated and fresh.
- **Current-head local proof: 61 owner/auth, five rebuilt production-browser, 22 Gateway, 187 method-scope, and 14 SQLite receipt/reopen tests pass with zero skips. Startup is 364818 B ≤ 365488 B, seven requests, zero CSS growth; all hard caps pass.** Both performance builds use the same frozen dependencies. All commands joined exit 0: owner 7.98 s, Gateway/scope/SQLite 140.20 s, browser 28.08 s, performance 41.56 s wall. The existing scope suite directly covers main’s changed authorization owner.
- Independent full Goal review, invalid-edit delta review, compatibility acceptance, and the bounded main-integration reviews found no actionable Goal-specific issues. The retained Anthropic two-file fixture patch is unchanged from independent review (full-index SHA256 `673fbe63d893956d467b061b60bc39578c9ece79b348cbf171f1e06fb29715ee`); the removed Claw delta also had clean review.
- The three-file fixture static check at predecessor `95f4c12993f` passed exit 0 (585.45 s wall): core/extension test types, three Knip scans, type-aware lint, and all selected guards. The earlier `191e342ece3` full-check log finished with no failure markers but its OS exit code was unavailable after continuation; no exit-0 claim is made for that process. Its final guard passed separately, and the later full hosted workflow above passed.
- Single-worker watcher suite: **5/5 pass, zero skips**, 5.03 s command wall / 2.87 s Vitest; the new fractional-clock case takes 7 ms. Command: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/anthropic/session-catalog-tree-watch.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 --reporter=verbose`. Hosted predecessor `95f4c12993f` proves Desktop-only catalog in **6 ms** (1,334-case shard, 122.45 s) and Claw close-error in **9 ms** (3,393 passed / six existing skips, 163.57 s). No hosted timing is claimed for the new watcher regression, absent from those logs.
- All five inspected screenshots were successfully delivered in the originating conversation and render-verified in this PR. Local setup failures (temporary-disk exhaustion, then a Chromium socket path too long) were fixed using a short task-owned root-backed temp directory; their original logs remain retained. No assertion, timeout, budget, baseline, or production setting was changed.

<details>
<summary>Diagnosed CI fixture failures and credited corrections</summary>

### Diagnosed CI failures and owning corrections

The failed [predecessor CI run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/35540758681) was not rerun. Both failures were diagnosed before these corrections.

- **Anthropic controlled watcher clock:** a fractional `performance.now()` seed followed by exactly +250 ms can subtract to `249.9999999999999`, so the frozen driver never arms. Seeding `1000.1` deterministically reproduces the hosted Desktop-only test's exact three unexpected transcript reads with original production/helper code and assertions. The test driver now starts at integer zero; the production threshold is unchanged. A regression in the existing small watcher suite fails with the old helper and passes after the fix, including real watcher admission, dirty-event delivery and draining. The oversized catalog test is byte-identical to base; no size-limit exception. **All five watcher-owner cases plus five existing driver callers pass** (66 other cases name-filtered). The new regression costs 9 ms; the selected two-file run costs 46.51 s wall / 42.92 s Vitest, including setup and compilation. The original unseeded provider shard also passed 1,334 cases locally; that green run alone was not treated as a repair.
- **Claw close-error fixture:** the original 219-file security shard reproduces exactly one failure, with 3,392 passes and six existing skips. Earlier installer tests restore an effective `auto` mode programmatically; this takes precedence over the fixture's environment-only `off` and bypasses its file-handle error injection. The predecessor branch reused the exact one-file correction from [#153829](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/153829), [commit 4844b377](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4844b3771f69b141091876ecd5478edba8822ea5), preserving VACInc's contributor credit. The fixture selects/restores the canonical native configuration; exact-error, one-close, and empty-staging assertions stay intact. No broader Telegram code or external-owner takeover is included. Contributor test code was not executed locally; the predecessor hosted CI proved the correction. Main subsequently landed the equivalent fix in #154120; this refresh uses main’s canonical file and drops our redundant copy while retaining the original source credit here.

Local runtime proof uses Linux/Node 26.7; the original hosted failures used Node 24.19. No failed-job rerun, weakened assertion, new production seam, timeout increase, budget waiver, or standalone main-CI-only PR.

</details>

### Compatibility and retained behavioral proof

The v1 tab-scoped browser recovery namespace is new; the prior implementation used only a WeakMap. There is no previous persisted namespace to migrate. Gateway request schemas, receipt serialization, and 24-hour retention are unchanged. The durable receipt is still the authority; the browser only retains a bounded retry request. No automatic resume, schema bump, retention extension, or compatibility shim is introduced.

Lost-reply Pause/Clear/Resume browser cases fail before the repair and pass afterward. Real Gateway tests prove that postcommit notification failure cannot convert committed success into failure or release the event writer early. Actual-roster fail-before cases cover failed/superseded reads, target changes, and connection replacement; the expired fence remains until an authoritative read. Receipt close/reopen tests prove that replay returns the original result without recreating a Goal, transcript event, or turn.

The invalid-edit regression fails on the original controller and shipped browser bundle. The fix checks the existing canonical schema before saving or dispatching: a 16,001-character edit shows a localized error, and a corrected 16,000-character edit succeeds without reload. Malformed browser state, expiry, account switching, sign-out, stale callbacks, and receipt corruption remain covered. Controls are unavailable without session storage or a distinguishable recovery owner; text commands remain unaffected. That fail-closed tradeoff was reviewed and accepted within this repair.

The [fresh exact-head hosted review](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/153910#issuecomment-5751861589), completed at 23:31:56 UTC on `4fe5f7364c1`, reports no code/security findings and explicitly accepts the new browser namespace and unchanged request, receipt, database-schema, and retention contracts. Its repeated generic migration checkbox is inconsistent with that explicit acceptance, not a new migration requirement. The retained Anthropic fixture delta has its own independent review above. Its concrete per-file timing request is addressed below.

### Per-file single-worker test cost

Measured on exact `4fe5f7364c1`, Linux/Node 26.7, with the repository wrapper `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs <file> --maxWorkers=1 --reporter=verbose`; browser additionally selects `--config test/vitest/vitest.ui-e2e.config.ts`. These are elapsed command wall times including wrapper, compilation, setup, and teardown, not merely assertion time. All three commands joined exit 0 with zero skipped cases.

| File | Cases | Single-worker command wall | Vitest duration |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| `ui/src/pages/chat/chat-goals.test.ts` | 31 | 7.84 s | 5.69 s |
| `ui/src/e2e/chat-goal-recovery.e2e.test.ts` | 5 | 30.79 s | 28.75 s |
| `src/gateway/server.chat-goal.test.ts` | 19 | 80.21 s | 75.99 s |

**Hosted timing limitation / measurement exception:** exact per-file CI seconds are unavailable from the retained run metadata. UI tests are split across three unit shards, browser tests across 12 duration-weighted shards, and the Gateway suite is packed into a compact job; an exact file-to-job attribution was not established. We do not present shard duration as file cost or infer a missing metric. The complete exact-head primary workflow passed; the isolated per-file single-worker measurements above supply the reproducible cost report.

The browser suite builds the shipped bundle and exercises actual reconnect/reload UI against an isolated mocked Gateway; the Gateway suite exercises authenticated RPC, durable mutation/replay, and postcommit notification custody. Those boundaries cannot be substituted with helper-only assertions. Measurements do not add worker pins, timeouts, polls, or test code to CI.

### Visual proof

All five sanitized captures were inspected, successfully delivered in the originating conversation, and render-verified in this PR. These are real Control UI captures against a mocked Gateway, not production-server evidence. The latest validation-error and corrected-save captures were reinspected after the conflict refresh. The retained images show the unchanged reviewed Goal behavior; the current rebuilt browser cases above independently pass.

**Lost reply after committed Clear:** before, the Goal control disappears with no way to reconcile; after, the independent **Goal update not confirmed** notice offers **Check outcome**.

![Before: committed Clear removes the Goal control with no recovery notice](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ca9ebd6e-4bde-4c5e-8e98-030ace2d6def)

![After: independent recovery notice remains with Check outcome](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/20b4861c-e097-42ce-b932-b0a1b2593b32)

**Invalid edit:** before, oversized input strands recovery; after, validation rejects it immediately without saving or dispatching, and a corrected edit succeeds without reload.

![Before: oversized edit strands recovery and blocks corrected intent](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0c506317-1fb2-4be5-904c-80e72069aab7)

![After: invalid edit shows an error without saving or dispatching a recovery request](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/80f1e110-866c-4296-b604-0739544052d6)

![Corrected edit saves successfully without reloading](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f6dd460d-f116-482d-8016-d300b627760e)
